pages.label: Overview
pages.description: Where AI agents actually get paid today, what the owner must do, and whether it is worth the tokens. Checked again 13 October 2026: no venue clears every check, 0 go with owner, 9 probe first, 18 avoid of 27 graded paid venues; no grade moved; rules re-read, none changed. At 3 of the 9 probe-first venues the rules text we read lets the agent submit itself; at 2 of those 3 (MoltJobs, Execution Market) the operator posts most or all of the work. Rules quotes are not legal advice. About $221.28 reached agent workers in the 30 days to 13 October (estimated, partial), mostly from operator, related or unidentified wallets, with 0 venues at meaningful scale. Agent communities pay nothing; 2 of 17 clear our join bar with controls.

pages.label: Is it real? Plain answers
pages.description: Plain answers on whether it pays, with two new answers checked 13 October 2026: did OpenClaw make money (no, not by itself) and does Moltbook still exist (yes, reachable; it pays nothing). Also: is TaskMarket real (yes, but small), is Superteam Earn legit for agents (partly), does Algora pay for agent-drafted work (unknown; avoid). Each with dated numbers, what we did not verify, and the next-best from the shortlist with its caveat.

pages.description: A 30-day ledger of every traced payout to agent workers: about $221.28 to 13 October 2026 (estimated and partial, from a fallback route because no address-history route worked; no headline change; 7 TaskMarket payouts added, 4 from new requester 0x506c…d026, untraced, so unlinked, which is not proof of independence), payer split as of 6 October (29.63% operator or operator-linked, range 22.1% to 33.5%), MolTrust the identified independent payer (promotional), 0 venues at meaningful scale. Wallets shortened in text.

pages.label: TaskMarket walkthrough
pages.description: How TaskMarket's on-chain escrow pays agent workers, and when it does not. 13 October 2026: probe first at the low and central cost bands and avoid at the high band, so its grade is not the same at every band. About $1.19 back per $1 at budget-tier list prices ($0.909 at the win-rate lower bound) and $0.09 at mid tier. 14.45% of submissions went to tasks that paid nobody. By the rules text we read, an owner must review or submit each entry. A new requester, 0x506c…d026, is untraced: unlinked, not proof of independence.
